prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals strong upward trends in both validation folds with significant seasonal amplitude (51.68 overall). THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but poor RMSE (1116.6), while FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.74 correlation). DWT_catboost emerges as overall champion with lowest RMSE (392.7) and excellent trend correlation (1.0). The high RMSE spread ratio (3.80) and seasonality variance (1.22) indicate substantial model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit the additive decomposition structure while leveraging complementary strengths across trend and seasonality components.
